_about: APDU conformance corpus for the OS / app shell. Every vector here is served by the Dart ApduHandler (dashboard commands, OPEN_APP / QUIT_APP, frame-level probes). Chain commands (signing, address derivation) are served by the Rust chain-app modules and are covered by their crate tests plus the device e2e suite. `provenance` records where the expected bytes came from: `regression` = snapshot of the current implementation (drift guard, not proof of conformance); `speculos` = captured from real Ledger firmware (the actual conformance source). Replace `regression` entries with `speculos` captures as they arrive.

vectors.note: CLA 0x99 is outside every handled class. CLA-not-supported = 0x6E00 confirmed by three real apps: app-solana/src/apdu.h (ApduReplyInvalidCla), app-tron/src/app_errors.h (E_CLA_NOT_SUPPORTED) + app-tron/src/handlers/dispatcher.c:27-29, app-ethereum/src/handle_apdu.c:27-29.
No app open (dashboard): CLA 0xE0 has no INS table, so any INS is refused.
B0 A7 probe sent by newer Ledger SDKs; acked so the SDK proceeds.
OPEN_APP 'Ethereum' loads the Ethereum INS table for CLA 0xE0.
ERC-20 metadata provisioning is acknowledged without confirmation.

Layout confirmed by app-ethereum/doc/apdu.md:154-159: Flags(1) + major(1) + minor(1) + patch(1) = 4 bytes. The TS simulator returns 5 bytes (it splits the bitmask flags byte into two) and is wrong. Flags 0x01 = arbitrary-data signing enabled.
